name: Ground beetles sampled from pitfall traps
abstract: The product contains quality-controlled beetle sampling data. Beetles are pitfall-trapped at core and relocatable sites, sorted, and identified to species/morphospecies. A subset is pinned; others are archived in 95% ethanol. Up to 467 pinned beetles per site per year are sent to an expert taxonomist for secondary ID to estimate parataxonomist uncertainty.
design: Uses 16 oz deli containers filled with 150 or 250 mL of propylene glycol. Trap counts changed over time: 40 traps/site (2013-2017), 30 traps/site (2018+), reduced to 18 samples/site/bout starting 2023.
change_log_highlights: 2022: YELL/BLDE flooding halted collection; eventID format updated to trap setDate
2021-2023: State-level taxa obfuscation adjustments (D01, D20 exceptions)
2023: Sampling reduced to 6 plots/site; date-exchange bug fixed
2024: Identification history tracking added; taxonomic updates
